instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. arrowhead size > undo restores the previous size: AssertionError: expected 'small' to be undefined (line 71). Test-setup bug, not a source bug: API.setElements([arrow]) assigns h.elements without recording to history, so the first captured change records the arrow as newly added and Keyboard.undo() deletes it (isDeleted: true) instead of restoring its size; API.getElement then reads the deleted element, still 'small'. Fix only this test's setup: seed the arrow with API.updateScene({ elements: [arrow], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) (import CaptureUpdateAction from "@excalidraw/element"), then select it, click arrowheadSize-small, assert 'small', undo, and assert the size is undefined and the element is not deleted. Remove the NOTE comment block at the top of the file (lines 1-7). Do not change any other test or weaken any assertion.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
